name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2025-12-18, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.78 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
